frontmatter_blocking._purpose: verify_tasks PreToolUse blocking scope. Entry condition: path starts with one of workspace_prefixes AND filename is not in meta_skip_filenames AND path does not contain any common_skip_dirs/content_skip_dirs AND not in exempt_workspace_prefixes.

frontmatter_vocab._purpose: verify_tasks.js frontmatter value vocabularies. related/topic/type: empty list = presence-checked only (any non-empty value accepted); populate to enforce a controlled vocabulary in your fork. canonical_tags: tags that always pass — non-canonical tags are still accepted if they look like proper nouns or contain non-ASCII (see isAllowedTag).
